sources.title: Arabic and Darija NLP Resources - GitHub
sources.snippet: A curated collection of resources and repositories for Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks specific to Darija, the Moroccan Arabic dialect. This repository aims to provide students and researchers with a comprehensive collection of tools, datasets, models, and code examples to facilitate Darija processing and analysis.
